payload_reviews.assessment: The two raw peptones observations do not establish feedstock, manufacturer, process or precipitation behavior. Manufacturer generic peptones include partial protein hydrolysates from plant, yeast or animal sources and acid, base or enzyme processing. Direct MeSH Peptones adds acid-or-enzyme and solubility/precipitation specifications; MICRO178 adds mammalian enzymatic/Bacto scope, MICRO174 enzyme scope and MICRO172 plant-or-animal scope. None is entailed for the entire unspecified generic owner. NLM D011492/M0017860 defines partial or extensive protein hydrolysates without those extra material restrictions. Retaining the local identity with NARROW_MATCH to mesh:D011492 is supported. Its therapeutic/nutrient indexing annotation is not a role assertion for this material. The complete payload preserves raw plural provenance, rejected truncated token, all old history/evidence, statistics and role/source holds. Conditional named-part references require separate source-specific review.
